All sources are SUPPORT L6 EVIDENCE with exactly one L4 IDX-CMF-PRODUCT-001 structural parent.
Each object retains at least one dedicated Source relation.
No node classification, Primary Domain, Source, Method, Project, or lineage mutation is included.
Serial exact-before-state application; stop on first drift/failure.
